standard_prerequisites.name: The functor from the colimit of the descent categories to the limit category is fully faithful, as shown for homomorphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the equivalence to essential surjectivity.

standard_prerequisites.name: Objects and maps can be glued along unions of opens from data on the pieces together with an identification on the overlap
standard_prerequisites.use: Assembles the descent datum for E over U and V into an object E_i over the union.

standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle for quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes allows statements about opens to be reduced to the affine case by successive extensions along unions
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the essential surjectivity to affine X_0 and S_0.

standard_prerequisites.name: For an affine limit the colimit of relatively perfect module categories identifies with the relatively perfect modules over the colimit ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Handles the affine case; the translation is done by the affine locally relatively perfect lemma.

core_obligations: Define the condition P for quasi-compact opens U_0 of X_0 asserting the colimit functor to D_{S-perfect}(O_U) is an equivalence; fully faithfulness is known by Lemma relative-descend-homomorphisms, so only essential surjectivity needs proof (proof lines 9125-9134).

Union step: suppose P holds for U_0 and V_0 and let E be S-perfect on U ∪ V; choose i and S_i-perfect preimages E_{U,i}, E_{V,i} with adjoint maps a, b to the restrictions of Rf_{i,*}E; by fully faithfulness, after increasing i, choose an isomorphism c over the overlap pulling back to the given identifications; apply Cohomology, Lemma glue to get E_i on U_i ∪ V_i with a map d to Rf_{i,*}E restricting to a and b; E_i is S_i-perfect (relative perfectness is local) and d is adjoint to an isomorphism Lf_i^*E_i to E, proving P for U_0 ∪ V_0 (proof lines 9136-9169).

Reduce to the affine case: by the same argument as in the proof of Lemma relative-descend-homomorphisms using the induction principle (Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma induction-principle), first work with opens of S_0 to reduce to S_0 affine, then opens of X_0 to reduce to X_0 affine (proof lines 9171-9180).
Affine case: the result follows from More on Algebra, Lemma colimit-relatively-perfect, with the translation into algebra done by Lemma affine-locally-rel-perfect (proof lines 9180-9185).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to essential surjectivity via known full faithfulness (proof lines 9125-9134).
Glue preimages over unions of opens via adjoint maps and the glue lemma (proof lines 9136-9169).
Reduce to the affine case by the induction principle (proof lines 9171-9180).
Conclude by the algebraic colimit statement (proof lines 9180-9185).
